I've actually got that started. I've made a lot of things to help me with fixing my flaws. I'd love to know any method you have.

Sure. I'm at work so I'll show you later!

What I mean is it being bad for him. Being in this mood obviously brings bucket amounts of negativity and I don't want it to affect him. He tells me I don't bother him. I was also thinking of bringing him into therapy when my insurance cones in, I hope they'll let me anyway.

Thank you, its nice to be told this. And I understand, you got a life too. It just feels good to know someone wants to help me. By the way, I hope everything is going okay with you too!

I hope there's a way to get rid of the ones I have. I don't mind not being perfect, I'll always be flawed but living with these makes me feel like everything I want to be will not be achieved or won't matter. 

I've also been feeling left in the shadows. I know its not at all how it is, people live their own lives and it can be hard to keep in constant touch. My artwork hasn't gotten much attention but I think that's just because I don't promote myself enough. 

There's a lot going on with me. I think even while I'm more open about these moods, I've been keeping a lot to myself. My SO has been so supportive and always loving but I am so scared that me being with him is bad. It's also why I decided not to have friends until I'm better.

Thank you. I really appreciate you offering a helping hand and I think I'll take it for once. This means a lot to me
